_readme: Amora's own money figures, preserved as DATA when they came out of client code (economics lane, 2026-09-03). Nothing loads this file at boot. It is applied by one authenticated admin PUT to /api/admin/content/money, the same way server/seeds/brochure-legal-seed.json is applied, because Amora already has a content row and the seed-on-empty path will never touch it. A fresh village writes its own figures in Admin, Content, Money & Value Claims and inherits none of these. Every value below is byte-for-byte what the pages published at d7526a4: no figure was changed, rounded, reformatted or re-worded when it moved.
depositRange: from $5k to $20k+ depending on the home type you're reserving
valueConversion: Converting {value} to cash, equity, or community currency is arranged directly with {village}, off the platform. A way to do it inside the platform is planned and is not built yet.
